source: 作者最终版渲染（teardown 工作台）：teardown nautilus-film，t=0.5s hero 镜头，1600x900 @ dpr1.2 = 1920x1080，含 HUD 面板；mask 为同相机的 --mask 剪影渲染（无 HUD、无地面阴影）

view.orientation: anterior-left (-X, tentacles), posterior-right (+X, whorl), dorsal up, port side toward camera (+Z); pure broadside
view.camera_type: hero: az 0 (drift +2.5 deg over 3.8 s), el 0, fov 28 (vertical), target (-0.18,-0.34,-0.07), d 32.4*0.9*1.2 = 34.99, view offset sx 15 / sy 21.7 px (CSS 1600x900)

density.principle: large-sparse / small-dense (大疏大密): dense focal cluster at umbilicus + dorsal window + eye, quiet outer shell plates
density.teardown_gate_numbers: gate-numbers.txt (hero): sil IoU 0.803, detail 1.05, dark 1.65, warm 0.30, far 1.29

sampled_from_reference_px.background: median of the studio backdrop outside the dilated mask and HUD boxes, lookcheck.background_stats (#E8E5DE)
sampled_from_reference_px.shell: lookcheck.color_layers shell band (L>=Otsu 51.6), 10-90 pct trimmed mean RGB over the mask (#D7D4CE, L84.8 h89)
sampled_from_reference_px.mechanism: color_layers mechanism band (L<51.6): the black seams, gaps, hardware, tentacle joints; near-black in this render (#2E3033, L19.5)
sampled_from_reference_px.warm_metal: color_layers copper band (h20-85, C18-45, L25-72), small share 0.7% (#6D4619)
sampled_from_reference_px.accent: color_layers accent band (C>=45, L>=35, h<=95): orange ring stack, iris, jet bands (#D16923)
sampled_from_reference_px.glow: brightest quartile of the accent band (#F48C55)
sampled_from_reference_px.light_kelvin: 5800 K, same neutral-warm daylight as the early cut (shell h89 vs bg h91)

notes: mechanism is near-black here (L19), unlike the early cut's silver (L~70): the metal read in the final cut comes from specular on the dark parts; the mech_dark gate compares against L19.5.
